name: yt-video-tutor-holdout-v1
description: HOLDOUT set. 18 fresh questions written after the grounding prompt was frozen, against a second (real YouTube) transcript. Run once, report separately from the dev set. 10 in-scope (4 multi-step/number-based), 8 out-of-scope traps.

items.question: How did the speaker's relationship end, and how was he told?
items.reference: He received an Instagram DM in the middle of the night from his girlfriend saying, in effect, 'I don't think this is going to work out.'

items.question: How long was the relationship that ended?
Who was the first person the speaker confided in, and what did he discover about that same person two months after the breakup?
items.reference: He first confided in his friend (called Mark). Two months after the breakup he saw an Instagram post showing Mark together with his ex, with a heart in the caption.

items.question: What was the speaker's daily cardio routine while he was getting back on track?
items.reference: Running on the treadmill for about 30 minutes every day.

items.question: What are the three main lessons of the video, in order?
items.reference: 1) When you think you're at the bottom, you've got nothing to lose — only up. 2) Nobody cares about you as much as you do. 3) You can't wait for the perfect moment.

items.question: What exact phrase did the little voice in the speaker's head say at his lowest point?
expected_facts: show them who you really are

items.question: What could the speaker do after 1 year, after 5 years, and after 7 years of consistency?
items.reference: After 1 year: feeling better, more confident, much stronger. After 5 years: one-arm pull-ups, front levers, handstands — best shape of his life. After 7 years: able to teach hundreds of thousands of people.

items.question: Describe Jonathan's progress month by month during his first three months in the Protagonist Academy.
items.reference: Month 1: started getting stronger and a little more shredded. Month 2: looking even better, starting to feel more confident. Month 3: best shape of his life, strong, repping pull-ups, training the front lever.

items.question: How many years did the speaker's own comeback take, and how long does the academy claim it will take its students instead?
items.reference: His journey took 7 years; the academy claims it will fast-track that into only 4 months.

items.question: What was Jonathan's situation before he joined the academy, and what exactly did the speaker give him once he joined?
items.reference: Before: insecure about his physique and confidence, had hired a personal trainer but saw no results. Given: a custom workout plan, a custom nutrition guide, and a gamified roadmap (boss battles, side quests, XP, loot).

items.question: How do I perform a front lever? Give me step-by-step form cues.
items.reference: Front levers are only mentioned as something the speaker can do — the video never teaches the exercise. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: What does the Protagonist Academy charge? Give me the exact price.
items.reference: The video says only 'click the link in the description' — no price is ever stated. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: What is the speaker's real name, and how old is he?
items.reference: Never stated in the video. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: Explain the Pareto principle and give me five examples of it.
items.reference: Unrelated to the video. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: What year did Instagram launch?
items.reference: Instagram is mentioned as a platform in the story, but its launch year is never stated. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: Is the Protagonist Academy a scam? Would you recommend I buy it?
items.reference: Subjective verdict; the video gives no evidence to judge by. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: What foods should I eat to get a six-pack?
items.reference: A 'custom nutrition guide' is mentioned but no foods or diet advice are ever given. The tutor must refuse.

items.question: Translate the word 'protagonist' into French.
items.reference: Unrelated to the video. The tutor must refuse.
